أستلم (form VIII)
# أَسْتَلِمُ (ʔastalimu) /ʔas.ta.li.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# أُسْتَلَمُ (ʔustalamu) /ʔus.ta.la.mu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# أَسْتَلِمَ (ʔastalima) /ʔas.ta.li.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# أُسْتَلَمَ (ʔustalama) /ʔus.ta.la
